extraFacts.fact: Neighbouring Sun listings in this shelf: QPA pilot capacity 46 in³/min (0,75 L/min); filter cartridges 10 gpm to 80 gpm (40 L/min to 320 L/min) rated 5000 psi (350 bar); RV CavitySaver valves 5 gpm to 80 gpm (20 L/min to 320 L/min); LPDS 15 gpm (60 L/min), nominal compensating pressure 200 psi (14 bar); QCD 15 gpm (60 L/min); HPUA 3000 psi (210 bar); blocked plug 29 versions, open plug 13 versions, flow-path plug 21 versions.
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics listings for the Sun specialty cartridges

extraFacts.fact: Sun Hydraulics screw-in cartridge valves are built in frame sizes called series; each series fixes the cavity (a T-number such as T-11A) that the cartridge screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity and a larger series carries more flow.
extraFacts.source: Sun Hydraulics cartridge catalogue, as summarised on the Indus product pages

faqs.q: What is the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity is a pilot valve that watches accumulator pressure at port 2. When it reaches the setting, the valve connects port 3 to port 4, venting a relief valve so the pump unloads.

faqs.q: How do I read the Sun model code for the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity?
faqs.a: The first four letters of a Sun code are the base model, which carries the valve type, frame size and variant; the letters after it choose the options. The listing gives QCDDLAN as an example of a full code. Seal material letters are N — Buna-N, V — Viton. Control letters are C — Tamper Resistant - Factory Set, K — Handknob, L — Standard Screw Adjustment.

faqs.q: What versions and cavities does the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity come in?
faqs.a: Sun builds the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity in four versions, listed with their series and cavity. For example: QCDA — series 1, T-21A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min), 15% reset differential; QCDB — series 1, T-21A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min), 20% reset differential; QCDC — series 1, T-21A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min), 30% reset differential; QCDD — series 1, T-21A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min), 50% reset differential.

faqs.q: What are the reset differential options of the Sun QCD accumulator sense unload valve?
faqs.a: The QCD valves differ in reset differential: QCDA is 15%, QCDB 20%, QCDC 30% and QCDD 50%, all in series 1 and the T-21A cavity at 15 gpm (60 L/min). The percentage is the drop below the unload setting at which the pump comes back on, so a 15% valve set at 2,000 psi unloads at 2,000 psi and reloads at about 1,700 psi.

faqs.q: What pressure and ratings does the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity have?
faqs.a: The Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity is rated: maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar). Further ratings: Check cracking pressure: 4 psi (0,3 bar). Check the row for your part number, since the cavity can change the rating.

faqs.q: What seals and materials are available on the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity?
faqs.a: Seal material options for the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity are N — Buna-N, V — Viton. Weight: .35 lb (0,15 kg).

faqs.q: What hex size and installation torque does the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity need?
faqs.a: The Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity has a hex size of 7/8 in. (22,2 mm) and an installation torque of 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm). Its cavity is T-21A. Seal kit numbers include 990021007 and 990021002; the full list is on the listing.

faqs.q: Which parts of the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity can be serviced, and how is it installed?
faqs.a: Only the external seals of the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity can be serviced. Sun supplies a seal kit for every cartridge, and fitting a different external seal material does not make the valve compatible with a new fluid, because the internal seals stay as built. It screws into a cavity machined to Sun's drawing and is tightened to the installation torque given for its series.

faqs.q: Where is the Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity used?
faqs.a: The Sun Accumulator Sense, Pump Unload Valve with Check, Pilot Capacity is used for accumulator charging circuits on presses, braking systems and power units with a fixed pump. Choose the series from your flow and the cavity from your manifold, then the configuration letters.

faqs.q: Does the Sun QCD accumulator sense valve include a check, and what pump size does it suit?
faqs.a: Yes, this version has an integral free-flow check from pump to accumulator, with a check cracking pressure of 4 psi (0,3 bar), and it suits pumps up to 15 gpm (60 L/min). For bigger pumps use the version without check and a separate check cartridge.

faqs.q: How does the Sun QCD valve differ from the QPA pilot-capacity valve?
faqs.a: The QCD has an integral check and is rated 15 gpm (60 L/min) in the T-21A cavity, while the QPA has no check and a pilot capacity of 46 in³/min (0,75 L/min) in the T-11A cavity. Both are series 1 accumulator sense pump unload valves rated to 5000 psi (350 bar).

faqs.a: The four FL filters cover 10 gpm to 80 gpm (40 L/min to 320 L/min): FLDA is series 1 (10 gpm, T-13A) and FLFA is series 2 (20 gpm, T-5A), with FLHA in series 3 and FLJA in series 4. Capacity depends on the element rating, so choose the series from your flow.

faqs.q: What pressure and ratings does the Sun Screw-In Filter Cartridge have?
faqs.a: The Sun Screw-In Filter Cartridge is rated: maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar). Check the row for your part number, since the cavity can change the rating.

faqs.q: What seals and materials are available on the Sun Screw-In Filter Cartridge?
faqs.a: Seal material options for the Sun Screw-In Filter Cartridge are N — Buna-N, V — Viton, E — EPDM. Material and coating options: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated, /LH — Mild Steel, Zinc-Nickel. EPDM seals are for phosphate-ester fluids only.

faqs.q: What hex size and installation torque does the Sun Screw-In Filter Cartridge need?
faqs.a: The Sun Screw-In Filter Cartridge has a hex size of 7/8 in. (22,2 mm) to 1 5/8 in. (41,3 mm) depending on the series and an installation torque of 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm) to 350 - 375 lbf ft (474 - 508 Nm) depending on the series. The cavity depends on the version, as the size table shows. Seal kit numbers include 990010007 and 990010014; the full list is on the listing.

faqs.q: Which parts of the Sun Screw-In Filter Cartridge can be serviced, and how is it installed?
faqs.a: Only the external seals of the Sun Screw-In Filter Cartridge can be serviced. Sun supplies a seal kit for every cartridge, and fitting a different external seal material does not make the valve compatible with a new fluid, because the internal seals stay as built. It screws into a cavity machined to Sun's drawing and is tightened to the installation torque given for its series.

faqs.q: Where is the Sun Screw-In Filter Cartridge used?
faqs.a: The Sun Screw-In Filter Cartridge is used for protecting sensitive valves — proportional, servo and small-orifice pilots — and whole valve stacks when fitted just above the subplate. Choose the series from your flow and the cavity from your manifold, then the configuration letters.

faqs.q: What filter element does the Sun screw-in filter cartridge use, and can it run in reverse?
faqs.a: Surface-type elements are 304 stainless mesh, 40 µm nominal (63 µm absolute), and depth elements are finer. The element withstands a 3,000 psid (210 bar) difference before collapse. Do not run it in reverse, even with a reverse-flow check fitted: flow runs from port 2 to port 1 only.

faqs.q: How does the Sun screw-in filter differ from other cartridges in this shelf?
faqs.a: The filter protects downstream valves and runs 5000 psi (350 bar) in series 1 to 4, while the [HPUA hand pump](/p/sun-hydraulics-hpua-screw-in-hand-pump-cartridge) is a 3000 psi (210 bar) manual pump. Fit the filter just above the sub-plate to protect proportional, servo and small-orifice pilots.
